children: These disclosures are from 13Ds filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission. 13Ds are filed within 10 days of an entity's attaining more than 5% in any class of a company's securities. Subsequent changes in holdings or intentions must be reported in amended filings. This material is from Aug. 20 through Aug. 26, 2026. Source: VerityData

Fortune Brands Innovations (FBIN)  Pictet Asset Management lowered its stake in the home and security products company to 5,887,646 shares. Pictet Asset Management did so through the sale of 1,885,093 Fortune Brands Innovations shares from June 22 through Aug. 18 at per share prices ranging from $40.98 to $54.01, and slightly offset those sales through the purchase of 53,637 shares from June 23 through July 31 at $41.46 to $54.55.

Following the latest activity, Pictet Asset Management continues to own a 4.9% stake in Fortune Brands Innovations' outstanding stock, placing Pictet Asset Management below the 5% threshold that would require it to report further sales. Shares of Fortune Brands Innovations have lost roughly 9.1% of their value since the beginning of this year.

Zenas BioPharma (ZBIO)  Enavate Sciences lowered its stake in the clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company to 3,245,404 shares. Enavate Sciences did so through the sale of 673,755 Zenas BioPharma shares on Aug. 19 at per share prices ranging from $31.05 to $32.

Following the latest sale, Enavate Sciences continues to own a 4.98% stake in Zenas BioPharma's outstanding stock, placing Enavate Sciences below the 5% threshold that would require it to report further sales. Shares of Zenas BioPharma have lost approximately 4.5% of their value since the beginning of this year.

Marriott Vacations (VAC)  Impactive Capital lowered its stake in the vacation ownership company to 3,380,818 shares. Impactive Capital did so through the sale of 750,000 Marriott Vacations shares on Aug. 19 at a price of $111.49 per share.

Following the latest sale, Impactive Capital continues to own a 9.8% stake in Marriott Vacations' outstanding stock. Shares of Marriott Vacations have gained roughly 97.7% in value since the beginning of this year.

Cimpress (CMPR)  Spruce House Investment Management lowered its stake in the customized print and marketing products company to 1,040,506 shares. Spruce House did so through the sale of 200,000 Cimpress shares from Aug. 18 through Aug. 19 at per share prices ranging from $90.13 to $90.32.

Following the latest sales, Spruce House Investment Management continues to own a 4.3% stake in Cimpress' outstanding stock, placing Spruce House Investment Management below the 5% threshold that would require it to report further sales. Shares of Cimpress have gained roughly 33.8% in value since the beginning of this year.

DLocal (DLO)  General Atlantic Partners lowered its stake in the cross-border payments company to 36,814,136 shares. General Atlantic Partners did so through the sale of 9,842,559 DLocal shares on Aug. 17 at an average price of $13.60 per share.

Following the latest sales, General Atlantic Partners continues to own a 21.4% stake in DLocal's outstanding stock. Shares of DLocal have gained approximately 10.2% in value since the beginning of this year.
